note: Media Entity Audio Streams adds a media SOURCE 'audio_stream' (AudioStream, allowed_field_types = {link}, default thumbnail audio.png; default name = basename of the link URI; prepareViewDisplay sets the source field to the audio_stream_html5 formatter) and a field FORMATTER 'audio_stream_html5' (for link fields; single boolean setting 'controls', default TRUE) that renders URLs in an HTML5 <audio> player via the theme hook 'media_audio' (template media-audio.html.twig; MIME guessed by file.mime_type.guesser, mapping audio/x-wav->audio/wav, passing audio/mpeg + audio/ogg). No settings form, no permissions, no Drush, configure=null; config schema provided. You use it by creating a Media type whose source is audio_stream (stored at media.type.<id> -> source: audio_stream, with a link source_field). Medium/hard cases create dedicated media types (mea_*) and read/write media.type.* config and the media source-field view display formatter.

evals.prompt: I want a Drupal Media type for audio that is referenced by URL (a stream / external file), not uploaded. The media_entity_audio module provides this. What media source do I choose, and what field type backs it?
evals.expected_output: Create a Media type and choose the 'Audio Stream' media source (plugin id audio_stream). Its source field is a 'link' field (allowed_field_types = {link}) holding the audio URL. Stored as media.type.<id> -> source: audio_stream.

evals.prompt: How does media_entity_audio render an audio-stream media item's URL to site visitors, and what single setting controls whether the play/pause controls appear? What is that setting's default?
evals.expected_output: It uses the 'audio_stream_html5' field formatter (on the link source field) which renders an HTML5 <audio> element via the media_audio theme hook. Its single boolean setting 'controls' toggles the transport controls and defaults to TRUE (controls shown).

evals.prompt: In media_entity_audio, how is each audio <source> element's type attribute determined, and which audio MIME types are supported out of the box (including any remapping)?
evals.expected_output: template_preprocess_media_audio guesses each URL's MIME type with the file.mime_type.guesser service and maps it: audio/x-wav is remapped to audio/wav, audio/mpeg and audio/ogg pass through, and anything else gets no type attribute on that <source>. When controls is TRUE the <audio> element gets the controls attribute.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site one Media type uses the media_entity_audio 'audio_stream' source. Inspect the live media type configuration and give the machine name of that media type.
evals.expected_output: The media type is mea_known: media.type.mea_known has source: audio_stream. Find it e.g. with: drush cget media.type.mea_known source

evals.prompt: The media type 'mea_ctrl' on this site uses media_entity_audio and its source field is displayed with the audio_stream_html5 formatter. Inspect the live default display configuration and state whether the HTML5 audio controls are enabled or disabled for it.
evals.expected_output: Controls are disabled: in the media.mea_ctrl.default view display, the source field's audio_stream_html5 formatter has settings.controls = false, so the <audio> player renders without transport controls.

evals.prompt: On this site, using the media_entity_audio module, create a new Media type with machine name 'mea_task' that uses the Audio Stream source so editors can add audio by URL. Wire up its link source field and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Create MediaType id 'mea_task' with source 'audio_stream', create the source field via the source's createSourceField() (a link field), save its storage + instance, and set source_configuration.source_field to it. verify passes when mea_task's source is audio_stream and the source field is a link field.

evals.prompt: On this site the media type 'mea_show' uses media_entity_audio and its audio player is currently rendered WITHOUT controls (the audio_stream_html5 formatter has controls turned off). Update its default display so the HTML5 audio player shows play/pause controls, and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In the media.mea_show.default view display, set the source field's audio_stream_html5 formatter settings.controls to TRUE and save. verify passes when the formatter is audio_stream_html5 and controls === true.
